  • Method Details

    • encrypt

      public String encrypt(String text) throws Exception
      Encrypts a plain text string using AES-GCM-256. Generates a random 12-byte IV, prepends to the ciphertext, and returns the result as a Base64 encoded string.
      Parameters:
      text - The plain text to encrypt
      Returns:
      A Base64 encoded string containing the IV and the ciphertext.
      Throws:
      Exception - If the cipher cannot be initialized.

    • decrypt

      public String decrypt(String text) throws Exception
      Decrypts a Base64 encoded ciphertext string generated by this class.
      Parameters:
      text - the Base64 encoded string containing the IV and ciphertext.
      Returns:
      The original decrypted plain text string.
      Throws:
      Exception - If decryption or authenication fails.
      IllegalArgumentException - If the input is too short.
